newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices and volume firm.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices and volume firm.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange volume firmed to 534 kg on Friday from Thursday's 475 kg on minor free market demand ahead of the weekend, dealers said.
Gold prices rose slightly to $354.00 an ounce and 1,432,000 lira per gramme from the previous $352.80 and 1,422,000 lira, in line with the firmer levels in world markets.
Dealers said a weak lira further raised lira term prices. The lira closed at 125,310 to the dollar versus Thursday's 124,730.
There was 334 kg traded in the first session, followed by 200 kg in the afternoon. Of the day's total trade, 81.1 percent was registered in lira terms.
